items.name: Toad-Hide Bracer
items.lore: Diamond-backed, and still faintly poisonous.

items.name: Lake-Knight's Ring
items.lore: Plain silver, with a wave cut in it.

items.name: Hatchling-Tooth Charm
items.lore: A tooth the length of a finger. From a hatchling.

items.name: Carn March Belt
items.lore: Stamped with a hoof-print.

items.name: Shore-Watch Mantle
items.lore: Lake-blue, with a knight's white border.

items.name: Gatekeeper's Red Key
items.lore: A red key under a little crown. It opens nothing you can find.

items.name: Ward-Breaker's Bracer
items.lore: Iron, dented from breaking stones.

items.name: Horn of the Hunt
items.lore: A small, curling horn of black bone. The hounds know whoever carries it.

items.name: Cwn Annwn Collar
items.lore: A red leather collar with a silver bell. The bell does not ring.

items.name: Harper's Cord
items.lore: Strung with old harp strings, each one tuned.

items.name: Nest's Shawl
items.lore: Thick Welsh wool, red and black. She made it for Iolo's wedding gift.

items.name: Huntsman's Grey Mantle
items.lore: Grey as mist, and as hard to hold.

items.name: Annwn-Bone Ring
items.lore: White bone that is cold to the touch, always.

items.name: Red-Ear Torc
items.lore: Twisted from a hound's red-dyed leash.

items.name: White-Hide Bracer
items.lore: White as milk, soft as moss. Lake-cattle hide, freely given.

items.name: Herd-Bell Charm
items.lore: A small bronze bell. It rings only near water.

items.name: Cythraul-Horn Charm
items.lore: A black horn tip. It smells of burnt stone.

items.name: Lake-Maiden's Ring
items.lore: Silver, cold, and always a little wet.

items.name: Hill-King's Crown-Shard
items.lore: A shard of rough gold. The King of the Barfog Hills wore it as a crown.

items.name: White Cow's Bell-Collar
items.lore: A bronze bell on a white leather collar.

items.name: Lake-Herder's Mantle
items.lore: Green wool, smelling faintly of rain and cattle.

items.name: Abbot's Psalter Charm
items.lore: A single vellum page in a silver case. The psalm on it is for the dead.

items.name: Vigil Cloak
items.lore: A monk's heavy brown cloak. Ghosts of soldiers once stood watch over it.

items.name: Evocatus' Ring
items.lore: A veteran soldier's ring, bearing the mark of a legion long gone.

items.name: Copyist's Bracer
items.lore: Ink-stained leather. The abbey's copyists wore them for three hundred years.

items.name: Legion-Pact Signet
items.lore: Bronze, with an eagle and a cross scratched over it.

items.name: Cloister-Stone Bracer
items.lore: Grey, cold, and heavier than it looks.

items.name: Crimson Letter-Case
items.lore: Red leather, sealed with a red key under a crown.

items.name: Acolyte's Red Cord
items.lore: A red cord, cut. It doesn't bind anyone now.

items.name: Fay-Knight's Gorget
items.lore: Green steel, worked like leaves. It hums.

items.name: Ellyll-Thorn Bracer
items.lore: Bark and thorn, grown, not made.

items.name: Glamour-Broken Ring
items.lore: It looked like gold. It's tin. That's the point.

items.name: Branwen's Gate-Seal
items.lore: A seal of black glass. The Gate's mark is on it - an open hand.

items.name: Gate-Captain's Belt
items.lore: Black leather with a red key for a buckle.

items.name: Knight of the Lake's Mantle
items.lore: White and blue, the Lake's own. Sir Bors's gift.

items.name: Lady's Promise
items.lore: A drop of lake-water in crystal. It never dries.

items.name: Sword-Oath Ring
items.lore: Silver, with a sword rising out of water.

items.name: Old-Ways Torc
items.lore: A torc of twisted reed and silver.
